messages.content: I am sorry to hear that you are going through such a profound sense of loss and identity crisis. It is incredibly painful to feel like an empty shell when the things that define you have disappeared overnight. Remember that this feeling of being alive yet detached is a common part of grief, but it does not mean you have literally died. If these thoughts of pretending your life is worth anything feel overwhelming, please consider reaching out to a counselor or a trusted friend immediately.
